messages:
jake: Heads-up team: profile_migration (v2.3 -> v2.4) scheduled in 10m. Change window 02:00-02:25 UTC. Read-only quiesce at 01:55. Plan: canary -> staggered shards -> backfill -> index. Deploybot will run. Docs: https://go/releases/4021

deploybot: PRECHECKS PASS. Canary target: shard-b. Holdpoint: WAIT_FOR_CANARY_PASS. Steps: (1) apply non-blocking DDL, (2) start rate-limited backfill (token-bucket), (3) concurrent index build, (4) feature-flag flip. Abort command: `deploybot abort 1741112223`.

priya: ack. I'll watch read latency + error panels for first 15m. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/xyz. Who owns restoring if we need snapshot?

dbops: If rollback needed: snapshot restore from pre-migration cluster-snap-2026-02-14. Procedure: 1) run `deploybot abort 1741112223`, 2) set FF `profile_schema_v2=false`, 3) route reads to replicas-only for safety, 4) coordinate restore with SRE. Expect ~25-40m RTO depending on shard.

mig-ops: Abort/trip criteria (addendum): - sustained replica lag >6s for >3m, - backfill queue length >1000 rows and rising for 2 consecutive 1m bins, - error rate >0.75% on profile writes or any new deadlock traces. If any hit, call abort and post reason in-thread.

jake: Request we pin API runtime to version v2026-02-10-prod for this window to avoid client schema drift. Can someone set that in release config?

deploybot: runtime pin applied: v2026-02-10-prod. Also created a short release note stub: "profile: add billing_country, tier; backfills historical country for legacy users. Monitor: read p99, replica lag, backfill queue."

deploybot: CANARY START on shard-b. Applying DDL now. Will report CANARY_PASS/FAIL.

dbops: watchpoint: running DDL on shard-b shows 0 waits, locks normal.

deploybot: CANARY_PASS on shard-b 52 No schema exceptions, no client errors reported. Proceeding to staged rollout to shards a,c in 3m.

priya: seeing small p50 uptick (~6%) on profile reads after DDL on canary, within expected. Watching p95 and p99.

mig-ops: note: concurrent index on shard-b started; expect brief replica lag increase. This is acceptable up to 6s as per runbook.

deploybot: STAGED ROLLOUT initiated for shards a,c. Backfill starting on shard-a with limiter throttle=500 rows/min. Will update every 2m.

priya: backfill queue depth currently 120 on shard-a, throughput 420 r/min. Lag stable.

dbops: adding additional abort condition: if backfill writes start hitting conflict-based retries >3% for 5m, abort.

priya: alert: replica lag on shard-c briefly hit 7.2s for 30s. Under mig-ops threshold?

mig-ops: 7.2s spike observed. Because it was <1m, we continue. If it sustains past 3m, we'll abort.

jake: If we do abort, also remember to rollback the feature flag rollout and coordinate client rollback notes to integrations.

deploybot: STAGED ROLLOUT complete for shards a,c. Index builds progressing. Estimated remaining time ~10m.

priya: p99 read latency trending +12% on one service path but not system-wide. continuing watch.

dbops: minor deadlock trace observed during backfill on shard-a, single occurrence. Not recurring. Monitoring.

mig-ops: still within thresholds. No action.

jake: if index time exceeds window and we risk overlapping next deploy, propose we pause further backfills and continue index concurrently, or extend window by 15m with PM sign-off. Thoughts?

priya: agree to pause new shard backfills if index will run long. I'll flag PM for +15m extension if needed.

deploybot: BACKFILL PAUSED (by request) for pending shards. Indexes continuing. Current run remains in-flight.

priya: All quiet now. No additional errors. Recommend sign-off at +20m if stable.

jake: Agreed. Tagging @oncall-sre for snapshot hold until we're green. Great job team :thumbsup:
